title: The Last Guardian
description: In a post-apocalyptic city where technology has failed and ancient powers have awakened, a lone warrior must protect the last sanctuary of humanity from supernatural threats. As darkness closes in, she discovers that the greatest danger may come from within.
tone: Epic and dramatic with moments of quiet introspection
setting: A crumbling megacity reclaimed by nature, with towering ruins and mystical energy
visual_vibe: Dark fantasy with high contrast, dramatic lighting, and ethereal effects

cast.name: Kira
cast.traits: Brave, determined, haunted by her past
cast.outfit: Worn armored cloak with mystical runes
